audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill from level 2 through first item, then Fiora at 2+ items — inverted against both the packet and the page's own text.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Fiora for rows 1-6 and Skill at 2+ items; whys[1]-[5] all describe Fiora out-trading, and whys[6] says he scales into the grouped dive.
audit.corrected: win[1..5] to Fiora, win[6] to Skill, with the full phases sides/ratings flipped as one group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanical errors: the page called Stormbringer (R) a shield, and it said Frenzied Maul (W) is on 'a long early cooldown'.
audit.why: Riot text: Stormbringer grants bonus Health and disables nearby towers — the shield in his kit is Sky Splitter (E), flat 16s, and only if he is inside the blast. Frenzied Maul is a flat 5s and its heal comes from the second cast into the same mark, so it is never on a long cooldown.
audit.corrected: Shield reattributed to Sky Splitter (E) in whys[4], spikes[1].text, mid and wants.you[2]; the W cooldown claim replaced with the real 5s / second-cast mechanic in whys[1], spikes[0].text and dosFull[2].d / dontsFull[1].d.

edits.after: Q-Lunge into a Vital plus E Bladework's guaranteed crit lands big damage before his W (Frenzied Maul) gets a second cast to heal off.

edits.after: Grand Challenge marks all four Vitals and the heal zone outlasts his W self-heal and his Sky Splitter (E) shield in the all-in.

edits.before: Q-Lunge into a Vital plus E Bladework's guaranteed crit chunks him while his W Frenzied Maul heal is on a long early cooldown — your first real health swing.

edits.before: Grand Challenge marks all four Vitals and the heal zone outlasts his W self-heal and R Stormbringer shield, so you win the 6-vs-6 all-in.
edits.after: Grand Challenge marks all four Vitals and the heal zone outlasts his W self-heal and the Sky Splitter (E) shield, so you win the all-in at 6.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you chain low-cooldown Lunges off every Vital proc and out-trade him as long as you respect the Q-stun-into-W-bite combo — never commit while his Q is charged. At 6 your Grand Challenge is the swing: mark all four Vitals, force the duel, and the heal zone eats through his W self-heal and outlasts his R Stormbringer shield. His R disables your tower and shields him for a dive, so track his jungler — a coordinated R-leap is the one thing that flips your 6.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you chain low-cooldown Lunges off every Vital proc and out-trade him as long as you respect the Q-stun-into-W-bite combo — never commit while his Q is charged. At 6 your Grand Challenge is the swing: mark all four Vitals, force the duel, and the heal zone eats through his W self-heal and the Sky Splitter (E) shield, a flat 16s. His R disables your tower and hands him bonus health for the dive, so track his jungler — a coordinated R-leap is what flips your 6.
